text:
Alex: heads-up — branch freeze goes live at 18:00 UTC today. Please avoid merges unless you have an exception. :alarm_clock:
Sam: copying — can we get a quick sanity pass on the canary plan later today?
Jun: putting my canary checklist in case it's helpful:
Jun: - tag rc/1.12.0-canary
Jun: - run smoke e2e (k8s + redis)
Jun: - small traffic split 5% -> monitor 15m
Maria: +1. Also a docs-only PR (tiny changelog tweak) just popped. Need late-merge?
Alex: if it's strictly docs & changelog, prefer to queue for post-freeze. Can you paste the diff here?
Maria: diff: `docs/CHANGELOG.md` add entry for 1.12.0 - typo fix. 2 lines.
Sam: given it's a user-facing changelog typo, I'm ok with exception if it's low-risk. We should still run a quick CI smoke.
Alex: ok — exception granted for docs-only. Maria, please: (1) run pipeline, (2) @Ryan (oncall) approve deploy window, (3) tag commit with `docs-exception`
Maria: running CI now. pinging @Ryan (oncall) for approval. :pray:
Ryan (oncall): saw this — fine as long as pipeline is green and no runtime artifacts change. Approving deploy window 17:45-18:00 UTC.
Release Bot: deploy-checklist: CI ✅, security-scan ✅, changelog diff size 2 lines ✅
Sam: quick reminder — if anyone needs a rollback plan, let's predefine the revert commit and notify #incidents.
Jun: for the canary if we see an error spike >3% in 5m we roll traffic back to 0% and deploy previous rc. I’ll prepare the revert PR now.
Alex: thanks. Logging this thread as the exception record. Maria, once merged, leave a one-line note in the release checklist about the docs exception.
Maria: merged and tagged `docs-exception-1769801234`. CI passed. Thanks everyone :tada:
Sam: pushing final changelog nudge to release notes owners.
Alex: closing the loop — freeze starts on schedule, docs exception recorded, canary plan set, rollback PR in flight. Good coordination. :thumbsup:
